messages:
maria: Quick async standup — kernel / batching / KV bench handoff
maria: What I did: refactored microbatch allocator, added fair-slot allocator to cut tail latency. Wired in a soft fallback that reduces target_batch_bytes on OOM.
maria: Blocker: seeing intermittent p95 spikes (~200-400ms) when slot-steal triggers under synthetic load. Haven't pinned root cause — could be eviction + slot reshuffle.
maria: Today: isolate repro, open PR with perf numbers, and handoff run to night shift.
sam: ack. can you paste the p95 spike trace or the small log snippet?
maria: here's the snippet i captured from the canary host:
```
[kernel] 2026-03-17T21:53:12Z slot=42 steal=start src=shard-7
[kernel] 2026-03-17T21:53:12Z reclaim=evict count=128 ms=7
[kernel] 2026-03-17T21:53:12Z request id=abcd p50=48ms p95=380ms p99=620ms
```
rik: looked through the PR diff. small nit in slot_allocator.go (nil check) but more importantly KV eviction_threshold in canary config is at 0.2 which is aggressive for bursty traffic. we should bump to 0.35 for the run.
jen: bench pipeline update: run #487 failed with OOM on bench worker 3, re-running with --mem=48G.
ci-bot: bench-run #487 failed: OOM at 2026-03-17T22:14:01Z (see https://ci.internal/bench/487)
sam: if OOM, short-term mitigation: reduce microbatch max_batch_tokens to 1024 and lower per-shard concurrency. also consider temporary kv.evict_rate throttling.
maria: will add logic in runtime: on OOM exception, reduce target_batch_bytes by 30% and retry once. adding to PR.
jen: re-run kicked off: https://bench.internal/runs/488 (expected ~2h)
rik: @maria please assign PR to me for review; i'll do a focused pass on the allocator and the eviction interactions after lunch.
maria: assigned. PR description will include before/after perf summary and the exact canary config used.
maria: quick before/after numbers from local microbench (99th pct sample):
```
baseline: p50=45ms p95=210ms p99=380ms
patch:    p50=42ms p95=180ms p99=310ms
notes: p95 drop looks promising, p99 still sensitive when eviction trips.
```
sam: nice improvement. once the CI run finishes, let's rebaseline the canary thresholds.
jen: night shift note: please monitor canary, alert if p95 > 250ms for >5min and if eviction_rate > 0.5 for >2min. i'll add the alert rules.
maria: thanks — leaving detailed handoff in the PR and a small checklist: 1) merge canary config bump -> 0.35, 2) merge PR, 3) watch run 488 logs, 4) rollback policy if p95 regresses.
rik: :thumbsup: i'll own the watch from 00:00-04:00 UTC.
sam: i'll follow up tomorrow with a short postmortem if run 488 surfaces any regression.
jen: thanks team. any docs to update (kernel allocator design) — file a short ADR after we merge.
maria: will write the ADR and link it in the PR.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: canary config updated in staging at 2026-03-17T23:05:12Z
jen: copy. good handoff.
